design.purpose: A thick two-colour chair pad for one adult seat, made with the photographed green and blue super-bulky yarn and 15 mm hook: 8 green rows and 8 blue rows, 16 single crochet per row.

steps.c: Place the green yarn on the work surface
Place the blue yarn beside the green yarn
Ch 17 with green yarn; Row 1: 16 sc
Rows 2–4: ch 1, turn, 16 sc each row
Rows 5–8: ch 1, turn, 16 sc each row
Cut the green yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail
Rows 9–12 in blue: ch 1, turn, 16 sc
Rows 13–16 in blue: ch 1, turn, 16 sc
Cut the blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail
Weave the green tail through nearby stitches
Weave the blue tail through nearby stitches
